description: Pylon B2B support platform with an API token and hosted OAuth MCP server.
auth_notes: Per third-party wrapper docs, an API token is generated in Pylon app settings; first-party API docs are not in sources.
gate_detail: Token is generated in Pylon's workspace settings per a third-party README, implying a Pylon account is needed. Plan, pricing or approval requirements are not stated in sources; no sandbox shown.
api_scope: Pylon API described by an OpenAPI spec per a third-party wrapper; hosted MCP covers issues, accounts, contacts and knowledge base.
mcp_notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP with OAuth sign-in. The pylonapi/@pylonapi/mcp package is a different product.
blocker_detail: Account and plan terms for API tokens unconfirmed; first-party API docs absent from sources.

evidence.quote: Generate a Pylon API token at https://app.usepylon.com/settings/api-keys .
An MCP server exposing the full Pylon API as Claude tools — auto-generated from Pylon's OpenAPI spec, so all 114 endpoints are available
The Pylon remote MCP server is a hosted Model Context Protocol endpoint at https://mcp.usepylon.com/
Pylon uses OAuth: the first time you connect, your MCP client opens a browser window to sign in and authorize access
Connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor to Pylon. Work issues, accounts, contacts, and your knowledge base with the permissions you already have.
